subject.title: Add native PowerShell smoke coverage for contributor commands

question: Which contributor commands should the native PowerShell Windows smoke lane run before this issue can close?
rationale: The coverage gap is valid and aligned, but adding recurring Windows runner work and choosing `check:docs`, `build:strict-smoke`, or a smaller passing subset requires maintainer CI-scope judgment already being handled in the linked PR.

options.title: Land focused smoke after proof
options.body: Require the linked PR or a replacement to run a small maintainer-approved command set under `pwsh` with passing Windows proof before closing this issue.

options.title: Narrow the command set
options.body: Accept only commands that already pass in native PowerShell and leave broader docs/build coverage for a separate issue or PR.

options.title: Defer Windows smoke coverage
options.body: Keep this issue open but pause implementation until maintainers are ready to spend Windows runner capacity on contributor-command smoke coverage.

recommendation.title: Land focused smoke after proof
recommendation.body: Require the linked PR or a replacement to run a small maintainer-approved command set under `pwsh` with passing Windows proof before closing this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-line blame ties steipete to the present CI workflow shape that would receive the new smoke step.
